title: Check Completeness of a Binary Tree
summary: Determine if a binary tree is complete by checking if every level, except possibly the last, is fully filled, and all nodes in the last level are as far left as possible, with a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 2^h nodes at the last level h.
statement: Determine if a binary tree is complete by checking if every level, except possibly the last, is fully filled, and all nodes in the last level are as far left as possible, with a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 2^h nodes at the last level h.
constraints: A complete tree fills all levels before the last, and last-level nodes occupy leftmost positions.
Return whether the tree is complete.

reference_solution:
def is_complete_binary_tree(root):
    from collections import deque
    queue=deque([root]);gap=False
    while queue:
        node=queue.popleft()
        if node is None:gap=True;continue
        if gap:return False
        queue.extend((node.left,node.right))
    return True
